entries.name: Oxidized multiwalled carbon nanotubes
entries.caption: Multiple-wall tube geometry is illustrative, not a measured chirality, wall count, diameter or atomic lattice. Red marks denote expected oxygenated sites (carboxylic acid, alcohol and ketone motifs), not a measured site map or a specified surface formula. Source composition and sample state remain separate from cartoon geometry.
limitations: Source-scoped identity or specimen schematic; no measured atomic coordinates.
